'''Barrage''' was the name of a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] serving in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They wore unique type of [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|commando armor]] with spikes protruding from the shoulders, knees, elbows, and [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]]. Barrage took part in a [[mission to Iceberg Three]], along with a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], another [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi General]], and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]].<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barrage first appeared as a purchasable outfit on the online game ''Clone Wars Adventures'' for 100,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic Credits]]. He later appeared as an NPC standing on [[Iceberg Three]].
